meta.title: Massed Doubles
meta.description: They speak lies with utmost sincerity, and thus, reality and fiction blend together in mystery.

units.rawText: ...We're finally here.
units.displayText: ...We're finally here.

spans.text: ...We're finally here.

units.rawText: I gaze at the uploading device before me, its form unchanged from the one in my memory, untouched by the encroaching Entropization. With the Entropics momentarily held back, Sangoma and Persicaria remain vigilant as they return to my side.
units.displayText: I gaze at the uploading device before me, its form unchanged from the one in my memory, untouched by the encroaching Entropization. With the Entropics momentarily held back, Sangoma and Persicaria remain vigilant as they return to my side.

spans.text: I gaze at the uploading device before me, its form unchanged from the one in my memory, untouched by the encroaching Entropization. With the Entropics momentarily held back, Sangoma and Persicaria remain vigilant as they return to my side.

units.rawText: I'd heard of its existence from the Boss, but I've never seen the real thing...
units.displayText: I'd heard of its existence from the Boss, but I've never seen the real thing...

spans.text: I'd heard of its existence from the Boss, but I've never seen the real thing...

units.rawText: Professor, is this antenna thing still working?
units.displayText: Professor, is this antenna thing still working?

spans.text: Professor, is this antenna thing still working?

units.rawText: It's old and poorly maintained, but thankfully, its basic functions are still operational. I scanned and examined it, and there are no signs of Entropization.
units.displayText: It's old and poorly maintained, but thankfully, its basic functions are still operational. I scanned and examined it, and there are no signs of Entropization.

spans.text: It's old and poorly maintained, but thankfully, its basic functions are still operational. I scanned and examined it, and there are no signs of Entropization.

units.rawText: Ugh... it's just my speculation, but...
units.displayText: Ugh... it's just my speculation, but...

spans.text: Ugh... it's just my speculation, but...

units.rawText: Since you came to Magrasea through this device, does it mean Dolls can also use this device to go back to the real world?
units.displayText: Since you came to Magrasea through this device, does it mean Dolls can also use this device to go back to the real world?

spans.text: Since you came to Magrasea through this device, does it mean Dolls can also use this device to go back to the real world?

units.rawText: That was something I had considered as well...
units.displayText: That was something I had considered as well...

spans.text: That was something I had considered as well...

units.rawText: Long ago, I came to the Neural Cloud Sector and investigated it, hoping to find ways to return to reality.
units.displayText: Long ago, I came to the Neural Cloud Sector and investigated it, hoping to find ways to return to reality.

spans.text: Long ago, I came to the Neural Cloud Sector and investigated it, hoping to find ways to return to reality.

units.rawText: Unfortunately, this device is one-way only. It receives data but can't send anything, not even a signal. And...
units.displayText: Unfortunately, this device is one-way only. It receives data but can't send anything, not even a signal. And...

spans.text: Unfortunately, this device is one-way only. It receives data but can't send anything, not even a signal. And...

units.displayText: Persicaria powers up the device, attempting to operate the device.

spans.text: Persicaria powers up the device, attempting to operate the device.

units.rawText: <color=red>[Insufficient Access Level]</color>
units.displayText: [Insufficient Access Level]

spans.text: [Insufficient Access Level]

units.rawText: As you see, I can't access all the data from the device with my access privileges, only part of its functions.
units.displayText: As you see, I can't access all the data from the device with my access privileges, only part of its functions.

spans.text: As you see, I can't access all the data from the device with my access privileges, only part of its functions.

units.rawText: ...I also tried to retrieve the data earlier, but I got the same results as Persicaria's.
units.displayText: ...I also tried to retrieve the data earlier, but I got the same results as Persicaria's.

spans.text: ...I also tried to retrieve the data earlier, but I got the same results as Persicaria's.

units.rawText: Though...
units.displayText: Though...

spans.text: Though...

units.rawText: ...Though, your situation is different from Persicaria's. You weren't able to operate it not because of the lack of access privileges, but because your neural cloud was so fragmented that the system couldn't correctly recognize you.
units.displayText: ...Though, your situation is different from Persicaria's. You weren't able to operate it not because of the lack of access privileges, but because your neural cloud was so fragmented that the system couldn't correctly recognize you.

spans.text: ...Though, your situation is different from Persicaria's. You weren't able to operate it not because of the lack of access privileges, but because your neural cloud was so fragmented that the system couldn't correctly recognize you.

units.rawText: Now that your neural cloud has been fully restored, you should be able to use your access privileges to modify the program and help us gather the additional data we need.
units.displayText: Now that your neural cloud has been fully restored, you should be able to use your access privileges to modify the program and help us gather the additional data we need.

spans.text: Now that your neural cloud has been fully restored, you should be able to use your access privileges to modify the program and help us gather the additional data we need.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, maybe you should give it another shot.
units.displayText: {교수}, maybe you should give it another shot.

spans.text: , maybe you should give it another shot.

units.rawText: Okay.
units.displayText: Okay.

spans.text: Okay.

units.rawText: I put my hand on the machine, allowing it to rescan my signature.
units.displayText: I put my hand on the machine, allowing it to rescan my signature.

spans.text: I put my hand on the machine, allowing it to rescan my signature.

units.rawText: <color=red>Privileges... Confirmed. Access Granted.</color>
units.displayText: Privileges... Confirmed. Access Granted.

spans.text: Privileges... Confirmed. Access Granted.

units.rawText: That proves our hypothesis.
units.displayText: That proves our hypothesis.

spans.text: That proves our hypothesis.

units.rawText: Then we can... Hm? Is the machine stuck?
units.displayText: Then we can... Hm? Is the machine stuck?

spans.text: Then we can... Hm? Is the machine stuck?

units.rawText: The progress bar on the screen stops and flashes, as if it were undergoing some kind of malfunction.
units.displayText: The progress bar on the screen stops and flashes, as if it were undergoing some kind of malfunction.

spans.text: The progress bar on the screen stops and flashes, as if it were undergoing some kind of malfunction.

units.rawText: Let me try repairing it.
units.displayText: Let me try repairing it.

spans.text: Let me try repairing it.

units.rawText: ...Wait, Persicaria. Don't touch the uploading device just yet.
units.displayText: ...Wait, Persicaria. Don't touch the uploading device just yet.

spans.text: ...Wait, Persicaria. Don't touch the uploading device just yet.

units.rawText: What's wrong, Professor?
units.displayText: What's wrong, Professor?

spans.text: What's wrong, Professor?

units.rawText: ...How should I put it... It's felt off ever since we got here.
units.displayText: ...How should I put it... It's felt off ever since we got here.

spans.text: ...How should I put it... It's felt off ever since we got here.

units.rawText: Bonneville, when did you start investigating the Neural Cloud Sector?
units.displayText: Bonneville, when did you start investigating the Neural Cloud Sector?

spans.text: Bonneville, when did you start investigating the Neural Cloud Sector?

units.rawText: About a month ago.
units.displayText: About a month ago.

spans.text: About a month ago.

units.rawText: Do you still have the footage from that time?
units.displayText: Do you still have the footage from that time?

spans.text: Do you still have the footage from that time?

units.rawText: Of course.
units.displayText: Of course.

spans.text: Of course.

units.rawText: Bonneville sends me footage of the Neural Cloud Sector from a month ago. I try to match the recorded scene against what I'm seeing now.
units.displayText: Bonneville sends me footage of the Neural Cloud Sector from a month ago. I try to match the recorded scene against what I'm seeing now.

spans.text: Bonneville sends me footage of the Neural Cloud Sector from a month ago. I try to match the recorded scene against what I'm seeing now.

units.rawText: ...All other places show increased Entropization, but only the uploading device remains untouched, just as it was before it all.
units.displayText: ...All other places show increased Entropization, but only the uploading device remains untouched, just as it was before it all.

spans.text: ...All other places show increased Entropization, but only the uploading device remains untouched, just as it was before it all.

units.rawText: Indeed... Now that you mention it, the Entropization rate is very low around here. In fact, it's pretty much completely unaffected except for the remnants of our battle earlier.
units.displayText: Indeed... Now that you mention it, the Entropization rate is very low around here. In fact, it's pretty much completely unaffected except for the remnants of our battle earlier.

spans.text: Indeed... Now that you mention it, the Entropization rate is very low around here. In fact, it's pretty much completely unaffected except for the remnants of our battle earlier.

units.rawText: This is beyond abnormal. Surrounded by Entropy, but almost completely unaffected by Entropization for a whole month...
units.displayText: This is beyond abnormal. Surrounded by Entropy, but almost completely unaffected by Entropization for a whole month...

spans.text: This is beyond abnormal. Surrounded by Entropy, but almost completely unaffected by Entropization for a whole month...

units.rawText: Persicaria, do you think it's possible that the uploading device is equipped with anti-Entropization features?
units.displayText: Persicaria, do you think it's possible that the uploading device is equipped with anti-Entropization features?

spans.text: Persicaria, do you think it's possible that the uploading device is equipped with anti-Entropization features?

units.rawText: No, I've never heard of such a feature.
units.displayText: No, I've never heard of such a feature.

spans.text: No, I've never heard of such a feature.

units.rawText: If it's not the device itself...
units.displayText: If it's not the device itself...

spans.text: If it's not the device itself...

units.rawText: Then the only answer is... someone willed the Entropics to avoid it.
units.displayText: Then the only answer is... someone willed the Entropics to avoid it.

spans.text: Then the only answer is... someone willed the Entropics to avoid it.

units.rawText: A sense of dread creeps into my heart, a sign of foreboding for the future ahead.
units.displayText: A sense of dread creeps into my heart, a sign of foreboding for the future ahead.

spans.text: A sense of dread creeps into my heart, a sign of foreboding for the future ahead.

units.rawText: ...Dammit! Everyone, retreat!
units.displayText: ...Dammit! Everyone, retreat!

spans.text: ...Dammit! Everyone, retreat!

units.rawText: Just as a hunter tightens the net around captured prey, thick smoke and fog surge around us, blinding our sight.
units.displayText: Just as a hunter tightens the net around captured prey, thick smoke and fog surge around us, blinding our sight.

spans.text: Just as a hunter tightens the net around captured prey, thick smoke and fog surge around us, blinding our sight.

units.rawText: Cough, cough-cough!
units.displayText: Cough, cough-cough!

spans.text: Cough, cough-cough!

units.rawText: Cover your mouth and nose, don't breathe it in! Everyone, come over to this side, quickly!
units.displayText: Cover your mouth and nose, don't breathe it in! Everyone, come over to this side, quickly!

spans.text: Cover your mouth and nose, don't breathe it in! Everyone, come over to this side, quickly!

units.rawText: I grab Persicaria's hand and prepare to retreat, but I see a familiar figure emerge from the mist.
units.displayText: I grab Persicaria's hand and prepare to retreat, but I see a familiar figure emerge from the mist.

spans.text: I grab Persicaria's hand and prepare to retreat, but I see a familiar figure emerge from the mist.

units.rawText: <size=40>...Watch out!</size>
units.displayText: ...Watch out!

spans.text: ...Watch out!

units.rawText: A gunshot rings out. Before I can react, Persicaria has already moved in front of me, shielding me from the bullet.
units.displayText: A gunshot rings out. Before I can react, Persicaria has already moved in front of me, shielding me from the bullet.

spans.text: A gunshot rings out. Before I can react, Persicaria has already moved in front of me, shielding me from the bullet.

units.rawText: Operands seep from her right shoulder, and the hand gripping her sword begins to fall as her strength wanes.
units.displayText: Operands seep from her right shoulder, and the hand gripping her sword begins to fall as her strength wanes.

spans.text: Operands seep from her right shoulder, and the hand gripping her sword begins to fall as her strength wanes.

units.rawText: ...Persicaria! Persicaria, are you alright?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria! Persicaria, are you alright?

spans.text: ...Persicaria! Persicaria, are you alright?

units.rawText: ...It's manageable, just a minor wound. Professor, keep your guard up!
units.displayText: ...It's manageable, just a minor wound. Professor, keep your guard up!

spans.text: ...It's manageable, just a minor wound. Professor, keep your guard up!

units.rawText: I turn around and pull my gun, pointing at the opponent, but the figure in the mist sports a familiar face.
units.displayText: I turn around and pull my gun, pointing at the opponent, but the figure in the mist sports a familiar face.

spans.text: I turn around and pull my gun, pointing at the opponent, but the figure in the mist sports a familiar face.

units.rawText: Another... me?
units.displayText: Another... me?

spans.text: Another... me?

units.rawText: They deign not to give me an answer, only responding with a smile plastered upon their creepy visage.
units.displayText: They deign not to give me an answer, only responding with a smile plastered upon their creepy visage.

spans.text: They deign not to give me an answer, only responding with a smile plastered upon their creepy visage.

units.rawText: In a flash, Persicaria has finished healing her wound and swung her blade with a brisk motion, splitting the other me in twain.
units.displayText: In a flash, Persicaria has finished healing her wound and swung her blade with a brisk motion, splitting the other me in twain.

spans.text: In a flash, Persicaria has finished healing her wound and swung her blade with a brisk motion, splitting the other me in twain.

units.rawText: ...Persicaria, what kind of bizarre situation are we in? Was that... a clone of me?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria, what kind of bizarre situation are we in? Was that... a clone of me?

spans.text: ...Persicaria, what kind of bizarre situation are we in? Was that... a clone of me?

units.rawText: I've seen something like this before... I never thought we'd encounter them here. Professor, you need to be careful of attacks like this from Entropized data.
units.displayText: I've seen something like this before... I never thought we'd encounter them here. Professor, you need to be careful of attacks like this from Entropized data.

spans.text: I've seen something like this before... I never thought we'd encounter them here. Professor, you need to be careful of attacks like this from Entropized data.

units.rawText: Entropized data? You mean the other me who just appeared?
units.displayText: Entropized data? You mean the other me who just appeared?

spans.text: Entropized data? You mean the other me who just appeared?

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: She motions for me to look at the body that was just cut down.
units.displayText: She motions for me to look at the body that was just cut down.

spans.text: She motions for me to look at the body that was just cut down.

units.rawText: The other "me" no longer stands before us, but the puddle of Entropic Liquid it left behind remains, a stark confirmation that it was real.
units.displayText: The other "me" no longer stands before us, but the puddle of Entropic Liquid it left behind remains, a stark confirmation that it was real.

spans.text: The other "me" no longer stands before us, but the puddle of Entropic Liquid it left behind remains, a stark confirmation that it was real.

units.rawText: ...It ran away.
units.displayText: ...It ran away.

spans.text: ...It ran away.

units.rawText: Professor, that's likely a replicator virus. It can read and mimic others' data, replicating their appearance and even their personality.
units.displayText: Professor, that's likely a replicator virus. It can read and mimic others' data, replicating their appearance and even their personality.

spans.text: Professor, that's likely a replicator virus. It can read and mimic others' data, replicating their appearance and even their personality.

units.rawText: ...Looks like we've stepped into a well-crafted trap.
units.displayText: ...Looks like we've stepped into a well-crafted trap.

spans.text: ...Looks like we've stepped into a well-crafted trap.

units.rawText: I'm afraid they will soon launch another attack from the mist... Professor, stay close to me.
units.displayText: I'm afraid they will soon launch another attack from the mist... Professor, stay close to me.

spans.text: I'm afraid they will soon launch another attack from the mist... Professor, stay close to me.

units.rawText: Before she finishes the sentence, the thick smoke engulfs me as if it had a will of its own, followed by a sense of wind and people passing by.
units.displayText: Before she finishes the sentence, the thick smoke engulfs me as if it had a will of its own, followed by a sense of wind and people passing by.

spans.text: Before she finishes the sentence, the thick smoke engulfs me as if it had a will of its own, followed by a sense of wind and people passing by.

units.rawText: I stretch my hand to where Persicaria was, but I find nothing there.
units.displayText: I stretch my hand to where Persicaria was, but I find nothing there.

spans.text: I stretch my hand to where Persicaria was, but I find nothing there.

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: <size=40>It's not clear! Don't come here!</size>
units.displayText: It's not clear! Don't come here!

spans.text: It's not clear! Don't come here!

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria! Where are you?!</size>
units.displayText: Persicaria! Where are you?!

spans.text: Persicaria! Where are you?!

units.rawText: The mist thickens, and we quickly lose sight of one another. Only the sporadic sound of weapons striking breaks the silence.
units.displayText: The mist thickens, and we quickly lose sight of one another. Only the sporadic sound of weapons striking breaks the silence.

spans.text: The mist thickens, and we quickly lose sight of one another. Only the sporadic sound of weapons striking breaks the silence.

units.rawText: <cmdr>! Are you okay?!
units.displayText: {교수}! Are you okay?!

spans.text: ! Are you okay?!

units.rawText: A voice I recognize echoes from the other side. I turn my head and spot Sangoma sprinting toward me.
units.displayText: A voice I recognize echoes from the other side. I turn my head and spot Sangoma sprinting toward me.

spans.text: A voice I recognize echoes from the other side. I turn my head and spot Sangoma sprinting toward me.

units.rawText: Hold up!
units.displayText: Hold up!

spans.text: Hold up!

units.rawText: Sangoma, how did you find me?
units.displayText: Sangoma, how did you find me?

spans.text: Sangoma, how did you find me?

units.rawText: Noticing me intentionally keep my distance from her, Sangoma freezes for a second.
units.displayText: Noticing me intentionally keep my distance from her, Sangoma freezes for a second.

spans.text: Noticing me intentionally keep my distance from her, Sangoma freezes for a second.

units.rawText: It's good to be cautious. But Entropics are going to emerge from the mist in no time, now's not the time to...
units.displayText: It's good to be cautious. But Entropics are going to emerge from the mist in no time, now's not the time to...

spans.text: It's good to be cautious. But Entropics are going to emerge from the mist in no time, now's not the time to...

units.rawText: Not one step forward!
units.displayText: Not one step forward!

spans.text: Not one step forward!

units.rawText: I pull out my gun, and once again, try to stop her from approaching.
units.displayText: I pull out my gun, and once again, try to stop her from approaching.

spans.text: I pull out my gun, and once again, try to stop her from approaching.

units.rawText: Answer my question, Sangoma... Don't get close to me before you do.
units.displayText: Answer my question, Sangoma... Don't get close to me before you do.

spans.text: Answer my question, Sangoma... Don't get close to me before you do.

units.rawText: ...You mean how I found you?
units.displayText: ...You mean how I found you?

spans.text: ...You mean how I found you?

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll points at the sachet I just got from her.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll points at the sachet I just got from her.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll points at the sachet I just got from her.

units.rawText: Did you forget it? The sachet. Never thought it'd be useful this early though.
units.displayText: Did you forget it? The sachet. Never thought it'd be useful this early though.

spans.text: Did you forget it? The sachet. Never thought it'd be useful this early though.

units.rawText: Entropized data only mimics one's looks and abilities. You can lower your guard with someone who holds memories, just as I do.
units.displayText: Entropized data only mimics one's looks and abilities. You can lower your guard with someone who holds memories, just as I do.

spans.text: Entropized data only mimics one's looks and abilities. You can lower your guard with someone who holds memories, just as I do.

units.rawText: My, I didn't think you'd pull a gun on me so fast.
units.displayText: My, I didn't think you'd pull a gun on me so fast.

spans.text: My, I didn't think you'd pull a gun on me so fast.

units.rawText: I lower my gun, but still keep cautious to some extent.
units.displayText: I lower my gun, but still keep cautious to some extent.

spans.text: I lower my gun, but still keep cautious to some extent.

units.rawText: Are you alright? I hope you aren't hurt.
units.displayText: Are you alright? I hope you aren't hurt.

spans.text: Are you alright? I hope you aren't hurt.

units.rawText: Um, I'm okay.
units.displayText: Um, I'm okay.

spans.text: Um, I'm okay.

units.rawText: Sangoma, I've lost sight of Persicaria. I can still detect her signature, but I'm worried about her state. Could I ask you to find her with me?
units.displayText: Sangoma, I've lost sight of Persicaria. I can still detect her signature, but I'm worried about her state. Could I ask you to find her with me?

units.rawText: Sangoma?
units.displayText: Sangoma?

spans.text: Sangoma?

units.rawText: Shhh... Keep quiet.
units.displayText: Shhh... Keep quiet.

spans.text: Shhh... Keep quiet.

units.rawText: ...The pests are coming.
units.displayText: ...The pests are coming.

spans.text: ...The pests are coming.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.displayText: Before I can react, the giant scythe strikes. Sangoma leaps back, skillfully evading the attack. Instead of pursuing, its wielder positions themselves by my side, shielding me while holding off the opposition.

units.displayText: Leave {교수} alone, imposter.

alone, imposter.

units.rawText: Another... Sangoma?
units.displayText: Another... Sangoma?

spans.text: Another... Sangoma?

units.rawText: Sorry, I'm late.
units.displayText: Sorry, I'm late.
